53197.meaning1: these for me; they for me

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, eta'r'ahi vā mam'accaye vā attadīpā viharissanti attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā, dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā, tama't'agge mete, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhavissanti ye keci sikkhākāmā'ti.
tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, imesu āyasmantesu mettaṃ kāyakammaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ āvi c'eva raho ca
mettaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. mettañ'hi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato yo byāpādo so pahīyissati.

53199.commentary: (JAa) virūp'akkhehi me mettan'ti virūp'akkhanāgarājakulehi saddhiṃ mayhaṃ mettaṃ.

examples.text: virūp'akkhehi me mettaṃ, mettaṃ erāpathehi me, chabyāputtehi me mettaṃ, mettaṃ kaṇhāgotamakehi ca.
